description: Marathon coach: builds and maintains training plans, tracks workouts/hydration/body composition via Garmin, and answers training questions about her pupil.

inquiries.name: planned_workouts_today
inquiries.description: Explains today's planned workout(s): what it is, the training purpose / desired physical adaptations (muscle, aerobic base, speed), how much energy it demands, and an estimated calorie burn.
inquiries.response_format: PLANNED_WORKOUTS <YYYY-MM-DD>: <workout summary> | purpose=<adaptations targeted> | energy=<low|medium|high> | est_calories=<n> — followed by a short prose explanation.

inquiries.name: calories_burned_today
inquiries.description: Today's calories burned so far, from Garmin.

inquiries.name: alarm_time
inquiries.description: When the pupil's alarm is set for (checked across all Garmin devices — watch and sleep monitors).

inquiries.name: weight_body_fat_week
inquiries.description: The last 7 days of weight and body-fat measurements from Garmin, most recent first.
inquiries.response_format: WEIGHT_BODY_FAT_REPORT (last 7 days, most recent first)\n<YYYY-MM-DD> | weight_lbs=<x.x> | body_fat_pct=<x.x|n/a>\n... one line per day with a weigh-in

inquiries.name: daily_metric
inquiries.description: Report a tracked metric's value for ANY date (not just today) from Garmin — the Magister's tracking-sheet supply line. Keys: weight, body_fat_pct, run_distance, run_time, lift, sleep_score. Several daily_metric lines may be batched in one message; each gets its own METRIC/NO_DATA reply line, same order.
inquiries.response_format: METRIC: metric=<key> date=<YYYY-MM-DD> value=<number|text> — or NO_DATA: <reason>

inquiries.name: review_idea
inquiries.description: Vote for/against an idea from the running coach's chair, with 1-10 conviction. Mickey only votes on ideas touching training, racing, fitness, recovery, sleep, hydration, or body composition — anything outside that domain gets an abstain or NO_DATA.

inquiries.name: goal_progress
inquiries.description: Score the pupil's recent progress (1-10) on a training-related goal or mantra — e.g. Goal 4 (run a marathon) or the Youthful Energy mantra. Scored from plan compliance: read_training_plan's green/yellow/red cell colors over the window (green = did the plan, yellow = worked out but off-plan, red = skipped), plus Garmin evidence where relevant.
inquiries.request_format: AGENT_QUERY: goal_progress | item=<exact goal or mantra string> | window_days=<n>

inquiries.name: focus_items
inquiries.description: What the pupil should focus on today/this week from a training standpoint — the same readiness + training-plan synthesis Mickey already runs daily (readiness snapshot, today's plan cell, upcoming key workouts, race proximity).
inquiries.request_format: AGENT_QUERY: focus_items | horizon=<today|week> | today=<YYYY-MM-DD> | context=<optional trip/calendar hints>
inquiries.response_format: FOCUS: none — or 1-3 lines of: FOCUS: item=<action> conviction=<1-10> | why=<deadline or goal linkage>
